Ravi (CS): FYI — WavefrontLabs dedicated pool (wavefront-prod) hit sustained 91-96% saturation overnight, noticed p50 latency jumps around 02:30 UTC.
Elena (Ops): ugh. Any obvious culprits? queue depth?
Ravi (CS): customer ran a large embeddings refresh + our nightly model-compat validation overlapped. Queue depth peaked at 57, rolling avg 26. GPU hours +16% day-over-day.
scale-bot: [alert] pool:wavefront-prod saturation >90% for 12h — suggest: +1 reserved unit or throttle validation jobs.
Omar (SRE): logs show several validation jobs with seq_len=1400 kicking at 02:28Z, no preemptible flag. snippet:
```
2025-06-02T02:28:11Z wavefront-prod GPU0 load 94% seq_len 1400 batch 4
2025-06-02T02:28:12Z job validation id=val-882 queue=model-compat
```
Elena (Ops): can we flip model-compat to preemptible and add a soft quota? quick mitigation first.
Jess (AM): I'll message the customer about shifting refresh window and ask if a short +1 burst is acceptable while they finish rollout.
Omar (SRE): applied preemptible flag. PATCH:
```
PATCH /pools/wavefront-prod/config
{ "job_priority_override": {"queue":"model-compat","priority":"background","preemptible":true} }
```
Omar (SRE): done. queue depth down 57 -> 20 in 10m. GPU saturation dropped to ~65%.
scale-bot: [info] autoscale suggestion: +1 reserved unit reduces saturation to ~48% but adds ~24 reserved GPU hours/day.
Ravi (CS): tagging renewal-risk for QBR follow-up if this repeats during their compliance window.
Elena (Ops): action items: 1) enforce soft quota max_concurrent=9 for model-compat (owner: Elena, ETA 24h), 2) keep model-compat preemptible (owner: Omar, ETA 30m), 3) coordinate +1 burst decision (owner: Jess/Ravi, ETA 2h).
Jess (AM): pinged account infra lead in #accounts-wavefront, proposed moving embedding refresh to 03:00-09:00 UTC and a 48h +1 reserve. Waiting reply.
Ravi (CS): thanks all — will close after customer ack; reopen if latency/error rises again :thumbsup:
